nodes.label: Invite-Only Onboarding
nodes.rationale: No self-registration or public tenant list; one-time sha256-hashed invite token (72h) redeemed at /auth/accept-invite.

nodes.label: Five Roles Permission Matrix
nodes.rationale: superadmin/admin/superviewer see tenant metadata only, never tenant users (PII) or courses; tenantadmin/user operate on tenant data.

nodes.label: Tenant-Owned Feature Checklist
nodes.rationale: Look up by id through the scoped repo so another tenant's id is a 404, not a 403; tenant id always from ctx, never request body/path.

nodes.label: TenantScopedRepository
nodes.rationale: Adds WHERE tenant_id = ? to every query; plain select() on tenant data outside it is how cross-tenant leaks happen.

nodes.label: X-Tenant-Slug Header Tenant Resolution
nodes.rationale: get_tenant_context returns the same 403 for unknown slug or another tenant so slugs cannot be probed.

nodes.label: check_migrations.py (round-trip + drift check)
nodes.rationale: Runs upgrade/downgrade/upgrade on a throwaway migration_check DB so the user's dev DB is never touched.

nodes.label: JWT Carries Identity Only
nodes.rationale: Roles and tenant are read from the DB each request so removing a user or changing a role takes effect immediately.

nodes.label: Layered Backend Architecture (endpoints/services/repositories)
nodes.rationale: Endpoints stay thin, services own the transaction and raise app errors (never HTTPException), repositories flush but never commit; keeps access control in api/deps.py and data access tenant-scoped.

nodes.label: Uniform Auth Failure Message
nodes.rationale: Same 'Invalid credentials' for every auth failure so emails/tenants cannot be probed.

nodes.label: Additive Before Destructive Migrations
nodes.rationale: Deprecate/backfill first (nullable, unmapped), drop later; irreversible drops need explicit user sign-off.

nodes.label: Refuse-Loudly Downgrade
nodes.rationale: If a downgrade cannot restore data, raise RuntimeError rather than silently lose or invent data.

nodes.label: Real-Postgres Integration Tests (no mocks)
nodes.rationale: Tests hit learning_platform_test via the ASGI app; schema recreated with create_all (models, not migrations) and tables truncated per test.
